title: Drop jmap_server crate-root re-exports from jmap-chat-mimi-server
description: Follow-up to JMAP-510h.39 (Mark 2026-10-23 option C). That decision dropped the crate-root `pub use jmap_server::{...}` block from the 10 named extension servers (mail, calendars, tasks, contacts, sharing, chat, scene, graph, vtc, filenode). crate-jmap-chat-mimi-server/src/lib.rs:127 has the same block (BackendChangesError ... SetObject, no AddedItem) but was not in the decision's list, so it was left as is. Decide whether to apply option C here too: remove the block, repoint internal crate:: imports to jmap_server, regenerate public-api/jmap-chat-mimi-server.txt, add a BREAKING line to CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-23: yes, apply JMAP-510h.39 option C to jmap-chat-mimi-server too: drop the crate-root pub use jmap_server::{...} block (src/lib.rs:127), consumers import from jmap_server; BREAKING in CHANGELOG; regenerate its public-api snapshot.
